evals.description: Contracts project architecture surface is documented and has no UI dependency violation
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-code-architecture to review src/Meridian.Contracts for module boundary drift and validation needs.
assertions: Must report zero UI dependency violations

evals.description: Shared UI services architecture surface identifies a shared UI layer
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-code-architecture to assess whether src/Meridian.Ui.Shared is the right shared seam for browser and WPF consumers.
assertions: Must identify Ui.Shared as an inspected project
Must avoid proposing UI-specific forks without evidence

evals.description: F# ledger project architecture surface is recognized as a ledger layer
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-code-architecture to assess src/Meridian.FSharp.Ledger without treating the F# project file as missing.
assertions: Must identify the F# project file
Must classify the project as ledger
Must not report a missing containing project
